Disciplined equity allocation for changing markets.

One transparent monthly rule combines market trend, sector leadership and U.S. interest rates to allocate across MSCI World and equity factors.

Performance

Indexed portfolio valueEvery portfolio starts at 100. Hover a line to inspect one value.

How the allocation is chosen

Three observable signals define the regime at month-end. The resulting allocation is implemented for the following month.

01

Market trend

MSCI World above or below its trailing 10-month average.

02

Sector leadership

The strongest three-month group: defensive, cyclical or innovator sectors.

03

Rate direction

U.S. 10-year Treasury yield versus three months earlier.

Evidence across time

Investable ETF evidence is separated from the longer academic factor proxy. The 2023–present period was not used to select the rule.

Academic factor returns extend the regime logic beyond ETF inception dates. They are research proxies, not directly investable portfolios.

Sharpe ratios use monthly excess returns over the U.S. 3-month Treasury rate (FRED DGS3MO). Transaction costs are included.

Methodology

Implementation choices for the investable ETF analysis. The long-horizon evidence uses corresponding academic factor proxies before ETF inception.
